notice: Static benchmark definitions, not current object measurements or assessment feedback. Completion details describe the assessed end state unless a process rule explicitly says otherwise. Evaluation notes distinguish additional scoring conditions. These definitions do not prescribe grasps, routes or recovery methods. Image-based estimates have uncertainty; numerical tolerances do not imply measured object precision. Official assessment is performed outside the policy.
benchmark_commit: panthera-so101-v1.1-step1 (native MuJoCo; not a RoboDojo task)

so101_base_m1_insert.completion_details: Final M1 pose relative to Base equals the CAD assembled pose (/work/cad/assembly.json T_base_motor) within: along the insertion direction at most 0.05 mm short of the designed depth and at most 0.6 mm past it (fully seated against its stop), lateral error 0.25 mm, orientation error 0.75 degree. The depth tolerance is one-sided because the retaining cap installed next fits only a fully seated M1. The station checks this after every finished action, fastens the part when it is within these tolerances, and reports `station.fastened` in the observation.
so101_base_m1_insert.process_rules: Base stays on the table and is never lifted.
so101_base_m1_insert.assessment_notes: Assessment uses the final state after the policy finishes and a short stationary hold.

so101_m1_cap_install.completion_details: Final cap pose relative to Base equals the CAD assembled pose (/work/cad/assembly.json T_base_holder) within: lateral error 0.25 mm, error along the seating direction 0.5 mm, orientation error 1 degree; M1 remains fastened within the same tolerances of T_base_motor. The station checks this after every finished action, fastens the part when it is within these tolerances, and reports `station.fastened` in the observation.
so101_m1_cap_install.process_rules: The Base+M1 assembly stays on the table and is never lifted.
so101_m1_cap_install.assessment_notes: Assessment uses the final state after the policy finishes and a short stationary hold.
